{{RV|type=function

|game1= tkoh
|version1= 1.00

|game2= arma3
|version2= 0.50

|gr1= Database

|descr= Add class to Scripted Database. The function modifies the passed array and returns a success flag.

|s1= [database, path, (value)] call [[BIS_fnc_dbClassSet]]

|p1= database: [[Array]] - database array

|p2= path: [[Array]] - path to class

|p3= value: [[Array]] - (Optional, default <sqf inline>[]</sqf>) the class' values

|r1= [[Boolean]]: True if class was added

|x1= <sqf>
private _db = ["#MILLER", ["&KILLS", 1000], "#TERRA", ["&WEAPON", "MX 6.5mm"]];
[_db, ["kavala"], ["&POPULATION", 42]] call BIS_fnc_dbClassSet;
_db // ["#MILLER",["&KILLS",1000],"#TERRA",["&WEAPON","MX 6.5mm"],"#KAVALA",["&POPULATION",42]]
</sqf>
